cases.name: an existing record
cases.reason: Fetching a record that exists should return it.

cases.name: an id that does not exist
cases.reason: A well-formed id that matches no record is a 404. A server error would mean the miss was unhandled.

cases.name: an id that is not a uuid
cases.reason: This endpoint keys on a UUID, so a bare number cannot identify anything. Unparseable input is a 400.
